author: Rainstruck
body:
I'm running out of things to play on my phone. I've mostly been playing hearthstone on it and I'm kind of getting bored of that. So does anyone have any suggestions for mobile games?

Heres mine: Jet car stunts. The sequel is good but the original one is the one that started it off and I would like to give a big nod to the makers of it.
